preprocessing.continuous_firm: within-month 1/99 winsorization, centered cross-sectional rank, missing value zero after centering, explicit missing indicator
preprocessing.binary_firm: retain 0/1, missing value zero, explicit missing indicator
preprocessing.categorical_firm: frozen-vocabulary one-hot encoding with unknown state
preprocessing.categorical_multihot_firm: frozen-vocabulary multi-hot encoding with unknown state
preprocessing.aggregate_state: strictly-past expanding z-score, sample standard deviation, clip to [-5,5], missing value zero, explicit missing indicator

cost_shadow.spread: one half of the observed full spread on each executed leg
cost_shadow.market_impact: 0.10 times square root of order dollars divided by 60-day median ADV
cost_shadow.side_position_count: separate eligible-side decile count for long and short
